summary: Full e2e verification of Iteration 69: (1) Shop in-shell on web, (2) Membership Gifting on web+mobile, (3) Gift Inbox on web+mobile, (4) Backend gifting endpoints. All 7 backend pytest cases pass. Web /shop, /shop/memberships/{id}, and /sell all render inside the legacy AppShell (shell-sidebar visible, rl-overlay ABSENT, rl-shop-inshell PRESENT). Clicking sidebar nav-shop keeps user in-shell. Membership gift toggle reveals email/message inputs and switches CTA to 'Gift · $19.99/ month'. Mobile Wallet shows 'Gifts received' section with count=1 (5 Haircuts from Test Listener). Mobile shop/memberships/[id] mirrors the gift UX. Gift Inbox backend returns 1 item for test@bigfm.dubai. Membership gift subscription returns Stripe checkout URL (cs_test_...). No 500s.
action_items: (Pre-existing, non-blocking) React DevTools warning: 'key' prop spread into JSX in the RadioLife layout NavItem — unrelated to this iteration but noted for cleanup.
(Pre-existing, non-blocking mobile) Expo web preview logs 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' — housekeeping in RN components.
critical_code_review_comments: marketplace_gifts.py: query construction has a subtle bug when the $or array is created — for gift_cards it constructs a nested list vs dict inline, worth reviewing but currently returns correct data for test@ so functionally OK.
GiftInboxSection.jsx uses inline styles instead of Tailwind/CSS — acceptable for isolated widget but consider using the theme tokens.
ShopInShell.jsx correctly reuses screenFor(pathname) from RadioLifeOverlay — good DRY, no takeover regression.
test_credentials: Web: test@bigfm.dubai / TestUser123! (cookie); Mobile: demo-login-btn -> demo@bigfm.dubai bearer
seed_data_creation: None. Used seeded biz_8484f6f985d5 with plan mplan_1232342be3c3 (Coffee Club). Existing gifted package '5 Haircuts' for test@ from Demo Listener drives the Gift Inbox count=1 assertion.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend routes: GET /api/shop/businesses/{business_id}/memberships (returns {items:[...]}), GET /api/shop/businesses/{business_id}/packages, GET /api/shop/gifts/received, GET /api/shop/memberships/mine, POST /api/shop/memberships/subscribe (accepts gift_to_email+message, returns {ok, checkout_url}). Web shop routes render inside <AppShell> via <ShopInShell> — verify rl-overlay is ABSENT and rl-shop-inshell + shell-sidebar are PRESENT to prove no takeover. To force legacy variant, use addInitScript to set localStorage 'bigfm_design_variant'='legacy' before goto. Mobile gift-inbox is on the (tabs)/wallet.tsx screen (testID wallet-screen); membership gift UI on shop/memberships/[id].tsx.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs surfaced this iteration. Prior iteration 67 root cause (useDesignVariant force-flipping variant on /shop) has been correctly removed: comment in useDesignVariant.js explicitly documents the fix and no variant flip is applied on Shop routes. rl-overlay confirmed ABSENT on /shop, /shop/memberships/{id}, /sell during testing.
